entries.title: 1898: Carl Gustav Witt discovers 433 Eros, the first near-Earth asteroid to be found.
entries.summary: Carl Gustav Witt was a German astronomer and discoverer of two asteroids who worked at the Berlin Urania Observatory, a popular observatory of the Urania astronomical association of Berlin.

entries.title: 2020: Israel–United Arab Emirates relations are formally established.
entries.summary: Diplomatic relations between Israel and the United Arab Emirates trace their origins to the early days of the Oslo Accords, where Israeli and Emirati diplomats had contact with each other in the 1990s in Washington, D.C.

entries.title: 1977: Members of the British National Front (NF) clash with anti-NF demonstrators in Lewisham, London, resulting in 214 arrests and at least 111 injuries.
